global_rule.description: Exactly two modes: Generate and World Editor. No control may exist in both modes unless explicitly listed.

generate.purpose: create candidate content; nothing saved unless explicitly promoted
acceptance_tests: absence: any version_control buttons not visible in generate mode

world_editor.purpose: maintain canonical truth; explicit actions and versioned
locks: version_read_only: if path starts with .versions/, editor is read-only
version_action_gate: if path starts with .versions/, hide save/revert/ai-assist
restore_flow: if path starts with .versions/, show 'Restore as New Canon Version'
dirty_state_gate: save/revert only visible when editor is dirty
acceptance_tests: absence: run_model_button not visible in editor mode
lock: editor is read-only when viewing .versions/ path
lock: save_button hidden when viewing .versions/ path

one_line_safety_test.question: If I click this right now, could I accidentally change canon?
If I click this right now, could I accidentally change canon?

static_checks: component_blacklist_in_mode: For each mode, assert that UI elements in 'remove' are not rendered
banner_checks: assert banners render according to mode
dirty_state_guard_check: navigation events are prevented when editor dirty
e2e_scenarios: generate_flow: open Generate, run model, promote output to world_db (validate only via explicit promote)
world_editor_flow: open Editor, make edit, save, save as new version, revert, load version
ai_assist_flow: select text, request assist, receive diff, apply confirm -> change persisted
